description: This file defines a helper class for generating JWT tokens for different user roles (admin and normal user) in integration tests.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A static helper class for creating JWT tokens with roles for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an admin user.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a normal user without roles.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Constructs a JWT token using specified username and roles.
